svg.aria-label: Observed counts, forecasts and MAE over 183 sequential one-day-ahead forecasts. The first two rules are estimated on the first 548 days; the weekly lag uses observations already available seven days earlier. Error units are rentals/day. Data: H. Fanaee-T, UCI Bike Sharing, CC BY 4.0.
